title: MineClash Capsules
description: Adds the capsules (plus extra) from TubeClash!
body:
**The official MineClash Capsule Mod**

_**The development of this mod is on hold and will be further developed in the future**_


This mod adds (almost) all capsules featured in the animated YouTube series Tubeclash/Finalclash, created by darkviktory studios, including those which never made it into the show (by not winning the related votes).

Obtained through the communitry ghosts, the capsules add helpful and fun gameplay features inspired by Tubeclash to your Minecraft experience!

![All available MineClash Capsules](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dbfbd80a42dd3bb8cbd250b7ff37ff940d6260d.png)

Each capsule has a different effect on the player and the world around them.
What do they do? Well, why not go ahead and find out yourself?

If you want can't wait, find out about it here:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Plain Capsule: Does nothing (only used for crafting other capsules).
- Fire Capsule: Shoots a fireball.
- Flight Capsule: Allows player to fly freely for a short period of time (Creative mode flight)
- Leaf Capsule: Spawns a random kind of vanilla tree.
- Force Capsule: pushes entities away from the user.
- Punch Capsule: Gives the player a strengh buff for a short time.
- Shield Capsule: Gives the user defensive effects for a short time.
- Weapon Capsule: Gives the user a random vanilla sword.
- Lighning Capsule: Shoots a lightning bolt wherever it is thrown.
- Time Capsule: Stops entities around the player for a period of time.
- Vision Capsule: Makes the user invisible for a short period of time.
- Wind Capsule: Launches the user upward.

</details>


_This mod is still in very very early stages of development. Updates will be issued in the future._

_All elements featured in this mod are inspired by TubeClash. This mod exists in no official relation to the series creators or darkviktory studios._
